title: Nutritious Garlicky Filipino Yukon Gold Potatoes Gratin
description: A garlicky, gooey, weeknight Filipino dish featuring Yukon gold potatoes, en-croute, macrobiotic-friendly, perfect for a satisfying dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and minced garlic.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
In a separate bowl, mix the shredded gruyere cheese and coconut milk.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes.
Pour some of the cheese and coconut milk mixture over the potatoes.
Repeat the layers until all the ingredients are used, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
